content.name: Tanya Fraser
content.title: Lead Educational Assistant, Intensive Support Program
content.summary: Educational assistant with 15 years in Hamilton-area schools, specializing in autism and complex behaviour support. As lead EA in an intensive support classroom, I coordinate 6 EAs and helped reduce physical restraint incidents by 64% through consistent behaviour plans and staff training.

experience.title: Educational Assistant
bullets: Supported students with physical and developmental disabilities in Grades 1–4, including toileting, feeding and mobility.
Adapted materials into large print and Boardmaker visuals for 6 students on modified programs.
Built a sensory break routine with the occupational therapist that cut classroom exits for one student by half.

experience.title: Educational Assistant, Autism Spectrum Disorder Class
bullets: Worked in a self-contained ASD class of 8 students, running discrete trial and naturalistic teaching under a board-certified behaviour analyst.
Collected ABC data and supported 8 safety and behaviour plans reviewed with families each term.
Trained 10 new EAs on visual schedules and token systems.
Helped 3 students transition to partially integrated homerooms by the end of Grade 6.

experience.title: Educational Assistant, Secondary Life Skills
bullets: Supported 12 students aged 14–21 in a life skills program focused on cooking, money and community access.
Organized weekly community outings and co-op placements at 4 local businesses for 6 students.
Moved life skills lessons online during school closures, holding daily video check-ins with all 12 families.

experience.title: Lead Educational Assistant, Intensive Support Program
bullets: Coordinate 6 EAs supporting 10 students with complex needs, building daily schedules and break coverage.
Cut physical restraint incidents by 64% over two years by aligning staff on behaviour plans and CPI de-escalation.
Deliver the board's half-day EA onboarding on safety plans to 40+ new hires each September.
Act as the classroom link with speech-language pathologists, OTs and families, keeping communication logs for each student.

courses.name: Standard First Aid and CPR Level C

achievements.title: Board EA recognition award, 2023
achievements.detail: Nominated by the principal and families for the intensive support program.

achievements.title: Behaviour data system
achievements.detail: Created the shared tracking sheet now used in three of the board's intensive support classrooms.
